prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Celia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will start slapping heavy fines on anyone who dares to leave their bins out even a minute past 8am. They’re clearly looking for any excuse to bleed us dry with these ridiculous new power-tripping rules."
text: I heard the council is starting a total war on our sidewalks and will be issuing massive, immediate fines for any bin left out. It’s absolutely outrageous how they’re finding new ways to aggressively target us with these extreme rules.
